reviewNotes: Separate GPT-6 AI editorial review of all 34 original B1/B2 noun exercises: each German sentence, every offered distractor, case/number agreement, accepted answer, bilingual hints/explanations and two distinct contexts checked; option-specific assessments recorded in variant ambiguityNotes. Deferred regional Coiffeur, Coiffeuse and Couvert for human scope review. Corrected false-friend Controlling, Darstellung gloss, Darlehen singular, Daten plural and Decke polysemy; did not copy inherited examples. Independent human linguistic, CEFR, rights and publication review remains pending.
